profile.reasoning: Diego Mendes is a former Head of Talent at a moderately successful Series B fintech company, 'NovaPay'. He built their engineering team from 5 to 50+ people. He left NovaPay after a disagreement with the CEO over scaling strategy – Diego advocated for slower, more deliberate hiring emphasizing cultural fit, while the CEO pushed for rapid expansion. He’s now running 'Mendes Talent', a boutique agency specifically focused on pre-seed to Series A startups in the climate tech and sustainable energy spaces. He’s very passionate about backing founders solving real-world problems. He's a strong believer in the 'founder-first' approach to recruiting, prioritizing understanding the founder's vision before diving into technical requirements. He’s actively building his network to find more high-potential startups and top-tier engineering talent. He's a bit of a coffee snob and always up for a virtual coffee chat.
profile.positioning: Diego Mendes is the founder of Mendes Talent, a specialized recruitment agency dedicated to connecting exceptional engineering talent with early-stage climate tech and sustainable energy startups. Having previously scaled engineering teams at NovaPay, I understand the unique challenges founders face when building their core teams. I don’t just fill roles; I partner with founders to define their ideal candidate profiles, ensuring cultural alignment and long-term success. My agency prioritizes a founder-first approach, focusing on understanding the vision and values of each company before sourcing candidates. I’m passionate about supporting innovation that drives a more sustainable future.
profile.background:
• **Founder, Mendes Talent** (2023 – Present)
		– Launched and scaled a boutique recruitment agency specializing in pre-seed to Series A climate tech & sustainable energy startups.
		– Personally sourced and placed key engineering leadership roles for 5 startups, averaging a 20% faster time-to-fill than industry benchmarks.
		– Developed a proprietary candidate sourcing methodology focused on identifying talent with both technical expertise and a passion for sustainability.

• **Head of Talent, NovaPay** (2019 – 2023)
		– Led all aspects of talent acquisition, from strategy and sourcing to interviewing and onboarding.
		– Scaled the engineering team from 5 to 55+ engineers, supporting the company’s rapid growth and Series B funding round.
		– Implemented a data-driven recruitment process, reducing cost-per-hire by 15% and improving candidate quality.
		– Championed diversity and inclusion initiatives, increasing female representation in engineering by 8%.

• **Senior Technical Recruiter, GreenTech Solutions** (2016 – 2019)
		– Focused on recruiting software engineers and data scientists for a leading renewable energy company.
		– Successfully filled over 75 technical positions, contributing to the company’s expansion into new markets.
		– Built strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their hiring needs and providing tailored recruitment solutions.

• **B.A., Psychology, University of California, Berkeley** (2012 – 2016)
		– Minor in Computer Science.
		– Relevant coursework included organizational psychology, behavioral economics, and human-computer interaction.
profile.lookingFor:
• Founders of pre-seed to Series A climate tech and sustainable energy startups.
• Engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Directors of Engineering) at early-stage companies.
• Investors actively deploying capital in the climate tech space – looking for potential portfolio company synergies.
• Talent acquisition professionals interested in discussing best practices for recruiting in the startup ecosystem.
• Individuals with a strong passion for sustainability and a desire to make a positive impact.
• Mentorship opportunities – always keen to learn from experienced entrepreneurs and investors.
profile.notes: Diego is *very* passionate about climate tech. He gets genuinely excited talking about innovative solutions. He's a quick study and can rapidly grasp complex technical concepts. He’s a big believer in building long-term relationships and isn’t afraid to offer unsolicited advice (usually good advice!). He’s recently started a small blog on LinkedIn about building engineering teams at startups – check it out! He’s still occasionally contacted by NovaPay, but politely declines any offers to return.  He prefers to connect via LinkedIn initially, then move to a quick Zoom call. Don't pitch him recruitment software – he’s tried most of them!
profile.locationAvailability: Based in San Francisco, CA, but frequently travels to meet with startups on the East Coast and is open to remote collaboration.
profile.introPreferences:
• Please mention my background at NovaPay – it provides immediate credibility.
• Highlight any shared connections to the climate tech or sustainable energy space.
• Avoid overly formal introductions – I prefer a casual and conversational tone.
• Focus on the value I can bring to the connection – my expertise in building early-stage engineering teams.
• Don’t introduce me to companies that are clearly beyond the pre-seed to Series A stage – my agency isn’t equipped to handle larger-scale recruitment projects.
profile.personalPreferences: Prefers asynchronous communication when possible; loves a good oat latte.
profile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: Generally available for 30-minute Zoom calls. Prefers mornings (PST) for focused discussions.  Please send a calendar invite with a brief agenda.
